 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Complete a cyclic sequence whose suffix is shifted back one cycle step per row."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Cells left of the diagonal are the unshifted sequence. The last row
    # exposes the sequence at every column except its final (shifted) cell.
    reference = list(grid[-1][:min(h - 1, w)])
    if not reference:
        reference = [next((v for row in grid for v in row if v), 1)]
    # Find the smallest repeating period in the visible unshifted prefix.
    period = len(reference)
    for p in range(1, len(reference) + 1):
        if all(reference[i] == reference[i % p] for i in range(len(reference))):
            period = p
            break
    cycle = reference[:period]
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            i = c % period
            if c < r:
                value = cycle[i]
            else:
                value = cycle[(i - 1) % period]
            row.append(value)
        out.append(row)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
